text.p: Tropical Cyclone Justin, with 85 mph winds, is in the Coral Sea, well east of Queensland, Australia, near 13s/152.7e, moving southwest at 6 mph. Justin should slowly weaken during this period as it tracks towards the southwest. It should be about 200 miles east of the Queensland coast in 72 hours with top winds of 55 mph. This system will continue to threaten shipping and boating in the Coral Sea during this period. Strong winds and rough seas will be a problems. It may eventually threaten the Queensland coast but it is too soon to tell.
There are no further emergency statements at this time.
